create_BlendParams: create a BlendParams instance with custom sigma, gamma, and background_color for soft rasterization
run_hard_rgb_blend: run hard_rgb_blend to produce an RGBA image using the closest face color per pixel
run_sigmoid_alpha_blend: run sigmoid_alpha_blend to produce an RGBA image with distance-based alpha blending from rasterization fragments
run_softmax_rgb_blend: run softmax_rgb_blend to blend top K face colors using 2D distance probability and z-depth weights
review_SigmoidAlphaBlend: review the _SigmoidAlphaBlend autograd function that wraps the C++ CUDA sigmoid alpha blend forward and backward passes
